question: Yash travels 204 km at 68 km/hr, the next 424 km at 53 km/hr and the next 366 km at 61 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey? (Corrected to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Average Speed** = **Total Distance** ÷ **Total Time**

Total Distance = 204 + 424 + 366 = 994 km

Total Time = (204 ÷ 68) + (424 ÷ 53) + (366 ÷ 61) = 3 + 8 + 6 = 17 hours

Average Speed = 994 ÷ 17 ≈ 58.47 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 58.47 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bac1af4b8fdb7e040a62d0a4ac5c2b7bd4f47168d297a3d24c8a7bd4f58be864.png] 

**Given:**

D₁ = 204 km, S₁ = 68 km/hr

D₂ = 424 km, S₂ = 53 km/hr

D₃ = 366 km, S₃ = 61 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = (D₁ + D₂ + D₃) ÷ (T₁ + T₂ + T₃)

**Calculations:**

⇒ T₁ = 204 ÷ 68 = 3 hours

⇒ T₂ = 424 ÷ 53 = 8 hours

⇒ T₃ = 366 ÷ 61 = 6 hours

⇒ Total Time = 3 + 8 + 6 = 17 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 204 + 424 + 366 = 994 km

⇒ Average Speed = 994 ÷ 17

⇒ Average Speed = 58.4705... ≈ 58.47 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 58.47 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If two equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, the average speed is (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

Relative speed is the sum of speeds if moving in opposite directions (S₁ + S₂) and the difference if moving in the same direction (S₁ − S₂).

Conversion Factor

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
